title: [main] Fix ELSTER UStVA 2026 XML export
summary: The ELSTER VAT advance notification export for Germany now uses the correct 2026 XML namespace and fixes the key-figure ordering to match the 2026 schema requirements, ensuring ELSTER accepts the exports.
key_points: Namespace selection updated to use v2026 from 2026 onward while preserving v2023 for earlier filings
Key-figure Kz90 now correctly follows Kz93 as required by the 2026 schema
New test cases added to cover monthly, quarterly, prior-year and future-year filing scenarios
quote: ELSTER rejects 2026 German VAT advance notification exports because they use the obsolete v2023 namespace.
